purpose: Trace what supports curriculum scope, learning-sequence decisions and source-selection boundaries without copying course material or pretending that a linked source reviewed this app.

supports: A1 scope: personal details and concrete situations
memorised phrase repertoire as a bounded starting point
repair, repetition and rephrasing as legitimate interaction support
does_not_support: awarding CEFR A1 from this app
copying a course or assessment item

sources.publisher: State Institute of Russian Language A.S. Pushkin
supports: an elementary path may include reading notices and restaurant menus
a phonetics-and-script prerequisite before a main communication module
greeting, introductions and ordering a restaurant meal as beginner-topic boundaries
does_not_support: reusing the institute's lesson content, audio or assessment
claiming that a small prototype has completed its A1 course

supports: talking about self, work and study at A1+ entry
ordering food in a café or restaurant as a beginner communication topic
does_not_support: treating a café task alone as a proficiency certification

sources.publisher: Lectorium / Tomsk Polytechnic University Russian-language teaching staff
supports: formal questions about name and origin in an elementary Russian sequence
separate phonetics, vocabulary and grammar practice at elementary level
does_not_support: copying its videos, exercises or answer key
a substitute for qualified review of each learner-visible string

sources.publisher: Science / American Association for the Advancement of Science
supports: retrieval practice can strengthen delayed retention more than additional studying in the reported foreign-language-vocabulary experiment
a correct immediate response alone should not be treated as permanent learning
does_not_support: a proficiency, fluency or efficacy promise for this app
using research results as phrase-level Russian-language review

sources.publisher: Psychological Science / Association for Psychological Science
supports: spacing effects depend on the relationship between practice interval and later test delay
a later return should be modeled as a distinct event rather than silently merged into initial completion
does_not_support: a universally optimal schedule for every learner
a claim that one delayed rehearsal proves durable retention
